death.attack.laevatein.burning_blade: %1$s was impaled and burned by Laevatein
death.attack.laevatein.burning_blade.pla: %1$s was impaled and burned by %2$s's Laevatein
item.laevatein.revenge_ledger: Revenge Ledger — Spider Nest Special Clause
tooltip.laevatein.revenge_ledger_1: Carry in inventory: triggers once upon fatal damage.
tooltip.laevatein.revenge_ledger_2: Restores full health and grants 10s of Extraordinary Tenacity.
tooltip.laevatein.revenge_ledger_3: Each hit costs at most 1 HP; 120s cooldown.
tooltip.laevatein.aggro_1: Right-click any mob to select the attacker, then right-click its target.
tooltip.laevatein.aggro_2: Sneak-right-click a mob to clear debug aggro and selection.
message.laevatein.aggro_invalid: Cannot start a duel between these entities.
message.laevatein.aggro_not_mob: Select an AI-controlled mob as the attacker; players cannot be controlled.
message.laevatein.revenge.marked: Oh? You were calling me? Fine. I'll remember you, %s.
message.laevatein.revenge.prepared: %s, you've got some nerve. If you want to see me that badly, I'll show you Laevatein fully released.
message.laevatein.revenge.anger: You again, %s? You're getting annoying. I don't have all day to play with you.
message.laevatein.revenge.release: Fine, %s. You've managed to piss me off. I'll show you what Laevatein looks like fully released.
message.laevatein.revenge.sealed_arrival: I heard you calling me, %s. Let's see what you've got.
message.laevatein.revenge.released_arriv: Say that again, %s. I want to see if you can still talk when I'm done with you.
message.laevatein.revenge.busy: I'm busy right now. I'll deal with you after I finish this. Don't get in my way.
message.laevatein.revenge.world_cooldown: I just finished dealing with the last one. Come back in about %s minute(s). Don't rush to your own funeral.
message.laevatein.revenge.personal_coold: I remember you. Don't bother me again for %s minute(s).
message.laevatein.revenge.no_landing: This place won't do. Find somewhere decent before calling me again; I'm not wasting my time here.
message.laevatein.revenge.peaceful: Peaceful difficulty? I have no interest in playing house with you.
message.laevatein.revenge.defeated: [The Middle Finger Never Forgets] Matthias has been defeated, but this grudge isn't over.
